name: OAHEvidenceStatus
title: OneAquaHealth Epistemic Evidence Status
publisher: OneAquaHealth Consortium - Semantic Interoperability Working Group
description: Epistemic validity and certainty classification for environmental health assertions.

concept.definition: Direct empirical ascertainment from physical field sensors or human observer reports without model inference.
Synthesized assertion derived from multi-source corroboration, predictive modeling, or algorithmic evidence fusion without definitive laboratory confirmation.
Reference verification established through analytical laboratory testing or formal public health epidemiological confirmation.
